---
title: "Line Equilibrium System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+yz\\
\dot{z} &=& ax-xy+bxz
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.3,b=0.1$ and initial condition $(2,3,-1)$.
